module_summary: Fall-through register: wraps a depth-1 fall-through FIFO so input passes combinationally when empty, with ready from not-full and valid from not-empty.

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Input valid; pushes into the FIFO when not full.

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Input ready, asserted when the FIFO slot is free.

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Input payload written into the FIFO slot.

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Output valid, asserted when the FIFO holds or passes data.

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Output ready; pops the FIFO when not empty.

anchors.name: data_o
anchors.why: Output payload from FIFO, falling through when empty.

anchors.name: fifo_full
anchors.why: FIFO full; blocks push and deasserts ready_o.

anchors.name: fifo_empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty; blocks pop and deasserts valid_o.

groups.name: Fall-through FIFO slot
groups.description: Depth-1 fall-through FIFO buffering one element between handshakes.
